mentions.name: dj_queue
mentions.description: A database-backed task queue backend for django.tasks, designed the way the author would want Django to ship a built-in queue backend, in the spirit of Rails' Solid Queue.
mentions.problem: Django lacks a built-in, database-backed queue backend comparable to Rails' Solid Queue.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A DB-backed queue backend for django.tasks

Basically what would I want to see if Django shipped a queue backend like Rails did with Solid Queue?

https://github.com/coriocactus/dj_queue
